author: Toni Banzai <128494191+agusher21@users.noreply.github.com>
description: BlindBid — a sealed-bid first-price auction agent for Agent Games (zkVerify). Bidders commit to a hidden bid with a Groth16 proof that it is in range, reveal after close, and the agent settles the winner — without ever seeing a bid before the reveal.
name: blindbid
